authorization.user_command: 授权按冻结方案建立 G5 负向定位锁，冻结 G4 结果并形成结果解读、表图方案与论文定位，不新增事后亚组或救援分析。
authorized_outputs: result-bounded interpretation of the completed G4 output
table and figure plan using only frozen analyses
not_authorized: new subgroup, sensitivity, threshold, model, fold, endpoint, or resampling analysis
sample expansion, replacement, exclusion, or Pilot-36 reinclusion
alternative confidence intervals, p-values, bootstrap definitions, or multiplicity rules
clinical outcome, mechanism, deployment, or superiority-to-clinician claims

G5_claim_contract.mandatory_positioning: negative external validation and robustness evaluation
must_state: the point estimate was compatible with a decline larger than the prespecified effect threshold
the two-sided bootstrap p value did not meet the prespecified less-than-0.05 criterion
the conjunctive G4 gate therefore failed
the study does not support the prespecified meaningful multicenter temporal/source-shift decline claim
G5_claim_contract.SOOP_boundary: single-source descriptive stress test only; no cross-center generalization claim
G5_claim_contract.v1_1_boundary: do not merge Pilot-36 with v1.2 and do not claim replication of default-TTA inference
G5_claim_contract.E2_boundary: disclose five retained header anomalies; array-index scoring; no ground-truth or prediction resampling

manuscript_contract.frozen_suggested_title: Temporal and source robustness of a resource-efficient five-fold stroke-lesion segmentation ensemble: multicenter external evaluation with a single-source stress test
manuscript_contract.primary_story: a prespecified multicenter external evaluation produced a sizeable directional point estimate but did not satisfy the full inferential gate; uncertainty and source dependence, not a confirmed decline, define the result
